thread:
jules_sales: Quick help please  LumenCare (healthcare regional) requesting a 3-month dedicated POC and asking for a 38% discount vs list. Need deal desk guidance — they want to start July 5.

anya_ae: Context: LumenCare could expand to 4 teams if POC succeeds; estimated ARR upside ~210k. They require EU residency and a SOC2 attestation; also sent a security questionnaire last week.

jules_sales: They're pushing because procurement got a verbal from a competitor at ~40%. Customer says 38% makes the internal procurement threshold.

matt_dealdesk: 38% is outside our standard eval concession band. Questions: is this against hosted list or reserved/dedicated pricing? projected token/compute burn for POC? any legal asks beyond SOC2/residency?

anya_ae: It's for Dedicated trial (2x A100 class), expected ~130M tokens/month with evaluation spikes. They asked for limited liability tweaks on PO and an expedited SOC2 report window.

oscar_infra: Ops note: blocking 2 nodes for 3 months will require capacity reservation and potential setup fees. We can try to schedule in a lower utilization window, but spikes may hit. Recommend an overage clause and surge protection.

carla_finance: Quick calc: 38% on dedicated infra reduces contribution materially. We can support up to 30% standard. We can make 35% possible with ARR commit >= $180k and an upfront invoice. Above 35% needs VP approval and strategic justification.

matt_dealdesk: Deal desk position: offer up to 35% for the 3-month POC if LumenCare agrees to: (1) sign SOW + PO pre-kickoff, (2) convert to 12-month paid commit within 30 days after POC at >= $180k ARR, (3) provide public reference + case study. Anything >35% requires formal VP escalation with documented ACV upside and marketing reference.

jules_sales: Customer insists 38% to get procurement over the line. They did mention they'd be willing to do a joint press quote.

carla_finance: I'm willing to consider 37% max if they sign a 12-month commit at >= $200k ARR and pay the first two months of the commit up-front. 38% only if legal accepts narrower liability cap changes and exec signs off.

matt_dealdesk: If you want to pursue >35% please compile: validated ACV (AE confirm), marketing/reference commitment, finance margin sign-off, and legal redlines attached. I'll queue VP review once we have those.

oscar_infra: For the SOW: include capacity bump clause, overage billing at list if usage >150% forecast, and an SLA toggle (trial = best-effort, production SLA post-commit).

legal_bot: Legal input: SOC2 attestation timing must be explicit in SOW. Data residency clause needs exact processing/storage wording. Liability cap stays at 1x fees for the trial unless legal escalates. We can't remove core MSA protections for PHI without C-suite approval.

jules_sales: Proposed internal counter to LumenCare (to send now):

```
Internal proposed terms:
- POC: 3 months (Jul 5 - Sep 4)
- Config: 2x A100-equivalent dedicated nodes, prefix caching enabled
- Discount: 35% off list during POC (conditional)
- Post-POC: 12-month commit at $180k ARR minimum, first month invoiced up-front
- Conditions: Signed SOW + PO prior to kickoff; SOC2 attestation within 30 days of kickoff; EU data residency language in SOW
- Ops: overage billed at list if usage >150% forecast; capacity bump clause included
- Legal: standard MSA + limited trial liability (1x fees)
```

anya_ae: LumenCare said they'd accept 35% if we put residency and SOC timeline in writing, and they agreed to a case study. They'll try to push procurement to accept 35% today.

matt_dealdesk: Provisional: 35% approved pending finance (carla) and legal sign-off. Attach SOW and security Q responses here for audit. If customer still demands 38%, escalate with the packet I outlined.

carla_finance: Confirming finance approves conditional 35% with the ARR >= $180k and first month up-front. Add an accelerator: if consumption >200% forecast during POC, we reserve right to true-up at list.

legal_bot: Uploaded SOW redlines in thread. I'll work with AE on residency language; SOC2 timeline confirmed as 30 days in SOW.

jules_sales: Sending 35% counter to customer now and attaching SOW draft. Will post PO if they sign.

anya_ae: Customer replied "accepted" via email and said procurement will issue PO by EOD. They asked for a single PO covering both POC and the first month of the commit.

matt_dealdesk: Once PO + signed SOW + finance confirmation are in thread, deal desk will finalize and mark concession approved. Good job team.

jules_sales: PO uploaded and SOW countersigned. Moving to contracting. Closing thread. :white_check_mark:
